spans.s: घंट m. A kind of dish, a sort of sauce.
घंटा f. 1. A bell; 2. a plate of iron or mixed metal struck as a clock.
घंटा-अगार n. a belfry.
घंटा-फलक m.n. a shield furnished with small bells.
घंटा-ताड m. a bellman.
घंटा-नाद m. the sound of a bell.
घंटा-पथ m. the chief road through a village, a highway, (दशधन्वन्तरो राजमार्गो घंटपथः स्मृतः).
घंटा-शब्द m. 1. bellmetal; 2. the sound of a bell.
घन (I) a. (f. ना) 1. Compact, solid, hard, शिलाघनं ताडकोरसि R.xi.18; 2. thick, close, R.viii.91, Am.
; 3. full, fully developed, तस्याः स्तनौ यदि घनौ Bhartr.i.18, कृता जघने Am.
; 4. uninterrupted, permanent; 5. deep; 6. excessive, great; 7. auspicious, fortunate.

घन (II) m. 1. A cloud, घनचयरुचिरे रचयति चिकुरे Git.G.vii., Megh.i.20; 2. an iron club, a mace; 3. the body; 4. the cube of a number (in math.); 5. extention; 6. a collection, a multitude, an assemblage; 7. talc.
घन (III) n. 1. A symbal, a bell, a gong; 2. iron; 3. tin; 4. skin, rind, bark.
घन (I) a. (f. ना) 1. Compact, solid, hard, शिलाघनं ताडकोरसि R.xi.18; 2. thick, close, R.viii.91, Am.
; 3. full, fully developed, तस्याः स्तनौ यदि घनौ Bhartr.i.18, कृता जघने Am.
; 4. uninterrupted, permanent; 5. deep; 6. excessive, great; 7. auspicious, fortunate.
घन-अत्यय, -अन्त m. disappearance of the clouds, the season succeeding the rains (शरद्).
घन-अत्यय, -अन्त m. disappearance of the clouds, the season succeeding the rains (शरद्).
घन-अंबु n. rain.
घन-आकर m. the rainy season.
घन-आगम m. the approach of clouds, the rainy season, घनागमः कामिजनप्रियः प्रिये Rt.ii.1.
घन-आमय m. the date tree.
घन-आश्रय m. the atmosphere, the firmament.
घन-उपल m. hail.
घन-ओघ m. a gathering of clouds.
घन-कफ m. hail.
घन-काल m. the rainy season.
घन-गर्जित n. 1. the thundering noise of clouds; 2. a deep loud roar.
घन-गोलक m. alloy of gold and silver.
घन-जंबाल m. thick mire.
घन-ताल m. a kind of bird (सारंग).
घन-तोल m. the Chātaka bird.
घन-नाभि m. smoke (being supposed to be a principal ingredient in clouds).
घन-नीहार m. thick hoar-frost or mist.
घन-पदवी f. the path of clouds, i.e. the sky, क्रामद्भिर्घनपदवीमनेकसंख्यैः Kir.v.34.
घन-पाषंड m. a peacock.
घन-फल n. the solid or cubical contents of a body or of an excavation (in math.).
घन-मूल n. cube root (in math.).
घन-रस m. 1. a thick juice; 2. extract, decoction; 3. camphire; 4. water.
घन-वर्ग m. the square of a cube, the sixth power (in math.).
घन-वर्त्मन् n. the sky, घनवर्त्म सहस्रधेव कुर्वन् Kir.v.17.
घन-वल्लिका, -वल्ली f. lightning.
घन-वल्लिका, -वल्ली f. lightning.
घन-वास m. a kind of pumpkin gourd.
घन-वाहन m. 1. Śiva; 2. Indra.
घन-श्याम (I) a. deep black, dark.
घन-श्याम (II) m. an epithet (1) of Rāma; (2) of Kṛṣṇa.
घन-समय m. the rainy season.
घन-सार m. 1. camphire, अपसारय घनसारं कुरु हारं दूर एव K.Pr.ix.; 2. mercury; 3. water.
घन-स्वन m. the thundering of clouds.
घन-हस्तसंख्या f. the contents of an excavation or of a solid (in math.).
घनाघन m. 1. Indra; 2. an intoxicated elephant; 3. a showering cloud.
घांटिक m. 1. A bell-ringer; 2. a bard who sings in chorus especially in honour of a king or a divinity; 3. the Dhattūra plant.
